analysis.summary: Accent Microcell Ltd held its earnings conference call on May 16, 2026, to discuss financial and operational performance for the half-year and fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. Management reported robust export growth, driven by premium products like MCC spheres and SMCC, alongside an overall volume of 15,000 metric tons. The commercialization of Unit 3 has faced delays due to external factors, abnormal monsoons, and regulatory approvals, but Phase 1 is expected to commence production by June. Management highlighted that increased raw material costs for wood pulp have been successfully passed on, and trading activities will decrease once expanded capacities go live. Accent Microcell Limited reported financial results for the half year and year ended 31st March 2026, highlighting growth in revenue and profitability.

guidance.claim: The company projected ₹70 crore revenue in Year 1 from its capacity expansion.

guidance.quote: at least say 15 to 20% CAGR for next 3 to 5 years. We are expecting.

demand_outlook.quote: there has been product. Inquiry has been increased, and we have been taking care of the business from our business side.

demand_outlook.quote: For export markets around 2 30 per kg. And for domestic is around 1 80 per kg.

demand_outlook.claim: The price of Croscarmellose Sodium (CCS) is about 3.5 times that of MCC.
demand_outlook.quote: The price of CC. CCS is around 3.5 times of MCC.

demand_outlook.claim: Global demand for MCC is around 250,000 metric tons while Indian market demand is 50,000 metric tons per annum.
demand_outlook.quote: We have 2.5 lakh is globally 50,000 metric ton for the Indian market.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry growth for MCC is expected to increase by 1 to 1.5% above the baseline 5 to 6% CAGR.
demand_outlook.quote: currently. if we talk about CAGR, so about 5 to 6% and upcoming times, at least for a couple of years, that would be. We are expecting to increase at least one to 1.5% more
